decisions.decision: Phase 7 (Gripper URDF + RViz) decoupled from Phases 1–6
decisions.rationale: USD→URDF + RViz integration is independent of calibration/wrapper pipeline and best done before first real-robot calibration so RViz preview shows actual gripper.

decisions.decision: 8-pose calibration set with face_down + face_forward + 2 side_pointing + 4 obliques (LSQ condition number 1.64)
decisions.rationale: Optimal conditioning (target <10) while keeping all gripper-tip positions in safe envelope. Dropped face_up (gripper at z=0.92m, overhead collision risk) and face_left_w2_pi (gripper at y=+0.19m, over robot base).

decisions.decision: F/T calibration is three layers: foundational (per-mount) + session smoke + per-pose zero
decisions.rationale: Industry-standard separation. Per-pose zero alone cannot fix wrong payload params — orientation-dependent bias was the symptom.
